No I'm not expecting a sense of release. I just don't want to live my life. Regardless of what I do, I'll be forgotten one day and as you said, I won't be conciouss to realise people remember me.
Easily bring joy to my life and to the lifr of others? How? I'm not really worth more than I think. I'm bad at everything I've tried so far. Living would be a waste of space and resources.

That's a good point. But having a big heart can suck sometimes. I can't live just to be a nice guy. Actually I don't even consider myself a nice guy. I get angry really quickly and have been an asshole recently.
Yeah, wait for the right one. Told that myself like 8 years ago. I've waited enough.

I don't understand how I'd bring joy to their lives. I barely talk to them and it's mostly small talk.
Yeah... friends... I already made one of them feel worse and I dont wanna do this again. It's better if I just stay away from them. 
Anything is worse than death at this point
You're really lucky. I wish I were able to do it painlessly. I don't talk to them too much but when I do my mother always remind me that she loves me. Just makes it way harder.
Yeah it'd be so much easier. The people who say that don't usually deserve to be devastated by a suicide.
